description: Thermally driven (single-effect LiBr-H2O) heat pump; COP_h = f(T_gen, T_evap, T_cond/abs) via characteristic equation (Hellmann/Ziegler form)

unit.name: Generic 100 kW_th single-effect LiBr-H2O absorption heat pump
unit.source: Hellmann & Ziegler (1999), Int. J. Refrigeration; Herold, Radermacher & Klein (2016), Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, 2nd ed., CRC Press

rated_cop_heating.note: Single-effect Type-I AHP at T_gen=90C, T_evap=10C, T_abs/cond=35C
